mechanism: Short-horizon FX dynamics differ between working and non-working calendar sessions because institutional order flow and market-making are materially thinner on non-working days, making same-session liquidity history more relevant.

retrieval_action: prefer historical segments with the same working_day

reason: Working-day status captures whether institutional desks are fully staffed; non-working sessions have distinct volatility and gap risk. Same-status retrieval avoids importing workday-specific order-flow patterns.
